sources.locator: Complete 239-page lecture-notes PDF; this batch inspected Simon §§3.2–3.3.2, PDF pp.35–39, and complexity §§13.2–13.3, PDF pp.122–126. The local full-text extraction was read for each cited passage.

contents.name: Promise problems and randomized bounded-error classes
contents.reason: The class discussion supplies the standard bounded-error convention; the local definition fixes finite random tapes and promise behavior explicitly.

contents.name: Indexed uniformity and circuit families
contents.reason: The notes describe indexed-gate uniform families; the local lemma proves the conversion to a complete list from the declared logarithmic-space interface.

contents.name: Exact quantum polynomial-time class
contents.reason: The class context is incorporated into a promise-specific QC14 definition with exact acceptance probabilities.

contents.name: Zero-error quantum computation conventions
contents.reason: The source supplies standard ZQP context; the item explicitly adopts a bounded-failure zero-error promise convention and makes no equivalence claim.

contents.name: Reversible computation and clean workspace
contents.reason: The reversible embedding idea is used as context; exact CCZ/Toffoli synthesis and the QC14 list bound are derived in the local proof.

contents.name: BQP counting and polynomial-space context
contents.reason: The standard containments motivate the stated obligations; the item preserves their exact-field proof requirements and does not claim a local proof.

contents.name: Classical and quantum promise-class inclusions
contents.reason: The standard class relationships are treated as context; this item proves its inclusions under the fixed QC14 promise interfaces.

contents.name: Randomness as a superposed finite tape
contents.reason: The circuit simulation context supports the construction; the exact finite-tape encoding, uniform generator, and acceptance count are proved locally.

contents.name: Simon’s promise problem and hidden mask
contents.reason: The Simon discussion supplies the hidden-mask setting; the local definition fixes table codes, promise disjointness, and XOR-oracle cost.

contents.name: Finite-register measurement during Simon sampling
contents.reason: The measurement discussion is contextual; the local lemma proves complete positivity, trace preservation, branch weights, and normalized states on two registers.

contents.name: Simon Fourier-sampling and sampled rank algorithm
contents.reason: The standard sampling procedure is adapted to the pair’s register order and instrument interface; query and gate costs are explicitly separated.

contents.name: Classical query collision lower bound
contents.reason: The collision intuition is a source route; the distribution over masks, posterior count, coupling, and adaptive bound are proved in full locally.

contents.name: Simon sample law and rank test
contents.reason: The Fourier-sampling law is contextual; the exact YES/NO distributions, rank correctness, union bound, and query count are proved locally.
